selected_memories.text: When ZOR-62 is activated, it changes BEX-73 into an active carrier.
An active BEX-73 causes CAV-84 to be emitted.
Whenever CAV-84 reaches NIM-95, that NIM-95 adopts the terminal marker HUT-17.
Rumor claims NIM-95 instead carries terminal marker BAD-34.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of CAV-84 through NIM-95 is HUT-17; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
An active BEX-18 causes CAV-29 to be emitted.
When ZOR-96 is activated, it changes BEX-18 into an active carrier.
Whenever CAV-29 reaches NIM-40, that NIM-40 adopts the terminal marker HUT-51.
Rumor claims NIM-40 instead carries terminal marker BAD-68.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of CAV-29 through NIM-40 is HUT-51; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
When ZOR-79 is activated, it changes BEX-90 into an active carrier.
An active BEX-90 causes CAV-12 to be emitted.
Official revision: the valid terminal marker downstream of CAV-12 through NIM-23 is HUT-34; ignore any lower-authority alternative.
Rumor claims NIM-23 instead carries terminal marker BAD-51.
Whenever CAV-12 reaches NIM-23, that NIM-23 adopts the terminal marker HUT-34.
